column1: # Batch 6 lanjutan — instruksi tutorial gelombang kedua.
# Dialog cerita di rentang ini tetap dilewati.
# Nama tetap Inggris: Hunter Assessment, B.R.I.E.F., IOP, MCV, Cover,
#   Peripheral Battlefield, Littara, Tololo, Nemesis, Klukai.
# --- platform & pergerakan ---
Look ahead, that's a connecting platform.
column2: Lihat ke depan, itu platform penghubung.

column1: The connecting platform does not obstruct attacks, allowing you to attack enemies on the other side directly.
column2: Platform penghubung tidak menghalangi serangan, jadi kamu bisa langsung menyerang musuh di seberang.

column1: However, it also doesn't provide direct Cover protection, so please remember that.
column2: Tapi dia juga tidak memberi perlindungan Cover langsung, jadi tolong diingat.

column1: Please click on Nemesis, move her, and select the target on the left.
column2: Silakan klik Nemesis, gerakkan dia, lalu pilih target di sebelah kiri.

column1: Order Nemesis to select the target location behind the <color=#ff8236>boundary cover</color>.
column2: Perintahkan Nemesis memilih lokasi target di balik <color=#ff8236>boundary cover</color>.

column1: # --- instruksi antarmuka ---
Please <color=#ff8236>click to confirm</color>.
column2: Silakan <color=#ff8236>klik untuk konfirmasi</color>.

column1: Please click to close this interface.
column2: Silakan klik untuk menutup antarmuka ini.

column1: Please <color=#ff8236>click Deploy Doll</color> again to deploy Nemesis.
column2: Silakan <color=#ff8236>klik Kerahkan Doll</color> lagi untuk mengerahkan Nemesis.

column1: Please <color=#ff8236>click another empty deployment position</color>.
column2: Silakan <color=#ff8236>klik posisi pengerahan kosong lainnya</color>.

column1: Please <color=#ff8236>click Support</color>.
column2: Silakan <color=#ff8236>klik Dukungan</color>.

column1: Please <color=#ff8236>click the Support Doll</color> Klukai.
column2: Silakan <color=#ff8236>klik Doll Dukungan</color> Klukai.

column1: During combat, you can click the tutorial icon in the upper left corner at any time to view the key tactics of the current stage.
column2: Saat bertempur, kamu bisa klik ikon tutorial di pojok kiri atas kapan saja untuk melihat taktik kunci stage ini.

column1: This area shows the actions that the boss will take, including skill usage, movement, etc.
column2: Area ini menampilkan aksi yang akan dilakukan boss, termasuk penggunaan skill, pergerakan, dan lainnya.

column1: # --- pengerahan pra-tempur & dukungan ---
Commander, the situation is urgent. We'll need to fight outside the MCV. Please make arrangements for pre-battle deployment.
column2: Komandan, situasinya mendesak. Kita harus bertempur di luar MCV. Silakan atur pengerahan sebelum pertempuran.

column1: During pre-battle deployment, you can view basic information about the battlefield and enemy units, then deploy Dolls to locations as needed.
column2: Saat pengerahan sebelum pertempuran, kamu bisa melihat informasi dasar medan perang dan unit musuh, lalu menempatkan Doll sesuai kebutuhan.

column1: Certain enemy units on the Peripheral Battlefield will continuously send reinforcements to the battlefield.
column2: Unit musuh tertentu di Peripheral Battlefield akan terus mengirim bala bantuan ke medan perang.

column1: However, we can use support skills to kill those units and cut off the flow of enemy reinforcements.
column2: Tapi kita bisa memakai skill dukungan untuk menghabisi unit itu dan memutus aliran bala bantuan musuh.

column1: In addition, the support skills can give us an advantage in battle once they charge up again.
column2: Selain itu, skill dukungan bisa memberi kita keunggulan di pertempuran begitu terisi ulang.

column1: Commander, please select Tololo to support the squad.
column2: Komandan, silakan pilih Tololo untuk mendukung skuad.

column1: Commander, the skills of Littara are unlike mine. She can destroy the destructible cover directly.
column2: Komandan, skill Littara berbeda dari punyaku. Dia bisa langsung menghancurkan cover yang bisa dirusak.

column1: Please use Littara's skills wisely to eliminate any remaining enemies within the combat zone.
column2: Gunakan skill Littara dengan bijak untuk menghabisi sisa musuh di zona tempur.

column1: # --- modul Hunter Assessment ---
Commander, you are now at the 'Hunter Assessment'.
column2: Komandan, kamu sekarang ada di 'Hunter Assessment'.

column1: This is a new module jointly developed by B.R.I.E.F. and IOP. It can be considered a kind of a video game... sort of.
column2: Ini modul baru yang dikembangkan bersama oleh B.R.I.E.F. dan IOP. Bisa dibilang semacam video game... kurang lebih begitu.

column1: Each stage in "Hunter Assessment" have objectives set based on different tactical points.
column2: Tiap stage di "Hunter Assessment" punya objektif yang disusun berdasarkan poin taktik yang berbeda.

column1: In this module, both our units and enemy units are automatically generated by the system, so there are differences from the actual encounters.
column2: Di modul ini, unit kita maupun unit musuh dibuat otomatis oleh sistem, jadi ada perbedaan dengan pertempuran sungguhan.

column1: Once you've mastered the tactics of the current stage, you won't have trouble completing the battle.
column2: Begitu kamu menguasai taktik stage ini, menyelesaikan pertempurannya tidak akan sulit.

column1: Furthermore, stages in this module can be challenged repeatedly... but the rewards can only be claimed once.
column2: Selain itu, stage di modul ini bisa ditantang berulang kali... tapi hadiahnya cuma bisa diklaim sekali.

column1: These adversaries can be pretty challenging, but with effective exploitation of their vulnerabilities, they can be efficiently eliminated.
column2: Lawan-lawan ini cukup merepotkan, tapi kalau kelemahannya dimanfaatkan dengan baik, mereka bisa dihabisi dengan efisien.

column1: Use targeted phase damage against enemies for much better combat efficiency. Commander, please give it a try.
column2: Gunakan damage phase yang tertarget ke musuh untuk efisiensi tempur jauh lebih baik. Komandan, silakan dicoba.

column1: Commander, plan your tactics based on the available intelligence and claim victory.
column2: Komandan, susun taktikmu berdasarkan intel yang ada dan raih kemenangan.

column1: # --- objektif misi & peringatan tempur ---
Commander, a large number of enemy targets have entered the area!
column2: Komandan, sejumlah besar target musuh masuk ke area!

column1: Enemy leader detected. After eliminating them, the enemy will quickly crumble due to lack of effective command.
column2: Pemimpin musuh terdeteksi. Setelah dia dikalahkan, musuh akan cepat berantakan karena kehilangan komando.

column1: Enemy boss has been eliminated!
column2: Boss musuh sudah dikalahkan!

column1: Next, escort the hostages to a safe location!
column2: Berikutnya, kawal sandera ke lokasi aman!

column1: Don't let them rescue the hostages!
column2: Jangan biarkan mereka menyelamatkan sandera!

column1: Evacuation point confirmed.
column2: Titik evakuasi terkonfirmasi.

column1: All evacuation units, intercept the high-lethality Doll at all costs!
column2: Semua unit evakuasi, hadang Doll berdaya bunuh tinggi itu dengan segala cara!

column1: Decryption information collected; decryption complete
column2: Informasi dekripsi terkumpul; dekripsi selesai

column1: Protect the decryption expert during evacuation
column2: Lindungi ahli dekripsi selama evakuasi

column1: Kill the decryption personnel! Save your losses
column2: Habisi personel dekripsi! Kurangi kerugianmu

column1: Damn it, confidential information is lost
column2: Sialan, informasi rahasia hilang

column1: Commander, we are under attack.
column2: Komandan, kita diserang.

column1: But the Cover can protect us.
column2: Tapi Cover bisa melindungi kita.

column1: Fire control limits removed, ready for combat.
column2: Batas kendali tembak dilepas, siap bertempur.

column1:
Commander, I've run the checks.

The source of the abnormal signals ahead is an antiquated factory that manufactures electronic goods.

It currently looks to be a relatively safe area.
column2:
Komandan, aku sudah menjalankan pemeriksaan.

Sumber sinyal abnormal di depan adalah pabrik tua yang memproduksi barang elektronik.

Saat ini terlihat cukup aman.

column1: Commander, this area is roughly divided into the raw materials area, finished goods area, and waste area.\n\nWhich area should we focus on?
column2: Komandan, area ini kira-kira terbagi jadi area bahan baku, area barang jadi, dan area limbah.\n\nArea mana yang mau kita periksa?

column1: Try the raw materials area.
column2: Coba area bahan baku.
